verdict.rationale: Parts of risk management can be automated headlessly: the Referrals API automates uploading block and trust lists, the Disputes API handles retrieving and defending disputes, webhooks and payment responses carry risk outcomes, OpenAPI definitions are published, and there is an official MCP server. However, core configuration (risk settings overrides, case review) is documented through the Customer Area UI, and nothing shows CI-driven management of risk profiles or rules. missing for 10: API or infrastructure-as-code control of risk profiles, custom rules and settings; a CLI or documented CI workflow; headless case-management review; independent hands-on corroboration.
